obligations.oracle: Compare exported accepted sections, immutable source hashes, generated descriptor field tables and exact accepted wire deltas. Source acquisition precedes fixture construction.
obligations.acceptance: No unreviewed field lost; inherited and FC08 differences separated; historical locks unchanged; complete source index.

obligations.oracle: Frozen effective catalog plus literal expected tables/independent numeric reference and byte vectors. Do not obtain expected values from DUT.
obligations.acceptance: Every logical case has all required variants, complete inputs and exact expected hashes; original seed vectors unchanged.

obligations.requirement: Bind real native, browser/WASM and headless profiles and inherited regression
obligations.oracle: Locked SDK resolution facts, successful relevant test-host build/load/discovery, real browser invocation and exact regression identities.

inherited_product_obligations: Ten families and sixty logical cases remain unchanged; product success is not required or claimed for this materialization task.
baseline_future_capability_policy: Actual missing new production feature produces explicit capability-absent/nonpassing product records. No compile failure, blanket NOT_RUN or mock-derived PASS as semantic evidence. Full future positive coverage must remain mapped, not removed.
